描述_EN: this one is decorated in underglaze blue with a stylised lotus design, simple banded lines and floral scrolls. it dates to the reign of the yongle emperor (1402-1424) of the ming dynasty (1366-1644). it is often referred to in chinese as a 'bianhu' and is also widely known as a pilgrim flask. the shape of this flask is based on a leather drinking flask traditionally used by the nomadic people of the north west regions of china. this kind of flask is typically of flattened ovoid or circular form.
描述_ZN: 此壶以釉下青花装饰，有风格化的莲花图案，简单的带状线条和花卷。 它可以追溯到明朝（1366-1644）的永乐皇帝（1402-1424）的时期。 它在中文中常被称为 "扁壶"，也被广泛称为朝圣者的酒壶。 这个酒壶的形状是基于中国西北地区游牧民族传统上使用的皮制酒壶。 这种烧瓶通常为扁平的卵形或圆形。
